titles.zh-CN: 找出目标数组中只出现过一次的元素

readmes.en: Find the elements in the target array that appear only once. For example：input: `[1,2,2,3,3,4,5,6,6,6]`，output: `[1,4,5]`.
readmes.zh-CN: 找出目标数组中只出现过一次的元素。例如：输入[1,2,2,3,3,4,5,6,6,6]，输出[1,4,5]

tests:
import type { Equal, Expect } from '@type-challenges/utils'

type cases = [
  Expect<Equal<FindEles<[1, 2, 2, 3, 3, 4, 5, 6, 6, 6]>, [1, 4, 5]>>,
  Expect<Equal<FindEles<[2, 2, 3, 3, 6, 6, 6]>, []>>,
  Expect<Equal<FindEles<[1, 2, 3]>, [1, 2, 3]>>,
  Expect<Equal<FindEles<[1, 2, number]>, [1, 2, number]>>,
  Expect<Equal<FindEles<[1, 2, number, number]>, [1, 2]>>,
]
